topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 27 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 5 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (oraclebase, erc20basic, blacklistable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
